limits: Thermal load retains all source heat at faster archivedsource1282000/.99 cadence; pulse transport and guide histories remain explicitly distinct from plant capture.
Prestress carries over the20kg/m2 frame,E2D1e8N/m,nu.2,8kg/m2 load layer and remaining joints. These are material/geometry acceptance conditions, not proof of local guide-network control.
Guide shield/buffer inventories must be named within1000kg/m2 services. Their refrigeration must fit the retained ordinaryaux allowance or receive a separate debit; no free added cooling.
Guide attenuation assumes closed local graphite shield and localized secondary energy deposition. Coupledguide-specific transport, heat access/quench and radiation lifetime remain unqualified.
The entireprompt pulse is conservatively put into cold surroundings for guidebuffer sizing even inEM20 cases. Uniform angular interception is explicit; changed sourceplacement needs re-evaluation.
